title: SIMAI Framework component set passport
description: The passport of one component set (standard simai.component-set): set.json at the root of the set's package folder. A set is one repository outside the free SIMAI Framework that holds its own Smart components, its Docara documentation site and its demonstrations. The passport names the set, its licence, the SIMAI Framework it is built over, the sets it needs, the name families it owns and every component it holds. SIMAI Framework keeps no reference of a set's components: this file is the only list. The builder copies it into the build and the release beside the receipt, stamped with the release block.

standard.description: The edition of simai.component-set the set conforms to.

id.description: The set id: the repository name without the ui- prefix (simai/ui-effects is effects). The same id is the package name in framework.lock.json, the name the rule file registers, the release tag prefix, the npm name @simai-studio/<id>, the page declaration and the owner in the shared name registry.

title.description: A short human title, for example SIMAI Effects.

summary.description: Optional: one or two sentences on what the set holds.

class.description: simai-pro: the one common SIMAI Pro licence of every paid set. framework: free, under the SIMAI Framework's own licence.

spdx.description: The SPDX expression of the class: simai-pro is PolyForm-Small-Business-1.0.0 OR PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 OR LicenseRef-SIMAI-Commercial; framework is Apache-2.0.

core_runtime.description: The lowest core.runtime passport version the set needs, as >=X.Y.Z.

source_revision.description: The full simai/ui-source commit the set is built and tested against; the same commit as framework.lock.json.

pair.description: Optional in the source, written by the release: the free SIMAI Framework release (ui-<12 hex>) built from source_revision.

range.description: An npm range over the required set's @simai-studio/<id> version.

requires_sets.description: Other sets whose components this set's components use. No cycle, at most two levels below the set; a page declares each one itself.

families.description: The name families the set owns: the first word after sf- of every element it holds. The shared name registry gives each family one owner.

docs.description: The set's Docara documentation site, on its own subdomain.

demos.description: Optional: where the demonstrations are served when not under docs.

components.description: Every component the set holds. SIMAI Framework keeps no copy of this list.

exports.description: Since 1.1.0 (standard simai.component-set 1.3.0; owner decision D17, 2026-11-11), optional: the set's scripted API, every name its bundle gives with SF.RuleLoader.registerPackage(<set>, {exports}) and a page reads as SF.package('<set>').<name>, in the entry shape of SIMAI Framework's core/contracts/public-js-api.json. A set that gives exports lists every one; its browser probe holds the list against SF.package('<set>') with simai/ui-source scripts/set-exports-kit.mjs. A set's own function (layer set) is documented on the set's Functions page, a component's script API (layer component) on that component's page; an internal name is not listed for authors.

source_revision.description: The set repository commit the release is built from.

release.description: Absent in the source; written into the built set.json by the release route.

element.description: sf-<family>[-<block>][-<variant>]; the family is one the set owns.

requires.description: Rules the component needs: of this set, of a required set or of SIMAI Framework.

element_aliases.description: Former tags kept as dated aliases (simai.change-lifecycle), with the set's journal record.

name.description: The export's key: a page reads it as SF.package('<set>').<name>.

status.description: public: a promise to a page, renamed or removed only through the set's change journal; internal: the set's own, may change in any release.

layer.description: set: the set's own function, on the set's Functions page; component: a component's script API, on the page of the element named in component.

component.description: With layer component, required there: the element of this set whose page documents the export.

audience.description: public: listed for authors; internal: not listed. An internal status is never listed.

author.description: One sentence for authors, present tense, no history: what the export does for a page.

doc.description: Optional: the slug of the documentation page that describes the export, on the set's site.

members.description: The members of an object export a page may read; the probe holds each one present.

deprecated.description: A dated alias the set's change journal records.
